name: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689)
source: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. Not re-assessed in this round (plan section 10).
changelog: 2024.1.0 (pre-release correction): incidentReportHours is 360 (Art. 73(2), 15 days), not GDPR's 72; Art. 73(3)-(4) shorten it to 2 or 10 days for widespread infringement or a death.

clauses.name: Risk Management System

evidence.fail: Risk classification or governing policy reference missing

clauses.gap: High-risk AI systems require a documented risk-management system (classification + board policy).

clauses.name: Data & Data Governance

evidence.fail: No bias-testing evidence or data dependencies recorded

clauses.gap: High-risk systems must document training data governance and bias testing (attach a bias_test artifact).

clauses.name: Technical Documentation

evidence.fail: Missing source traceability or substantive purpose documentation

clauses.gap: High-risk AI systems must have complete technical documentation including source traceability.

clauses.name: Record-Keeping (Automatic Logs)

evidence.pass: {ledgerEventCount} ledger event(s), {driftReportCount} drift evaluation(s) on record
evidence.fail: Insufficient operational records: model needs ledger history and drift evaluations

clauses.gap: High-risk systems require automatically generated operational logs (ledger events + drift evaluations).

clauses.name: Human Oversight Gate
clauses.gap: High-risk systems require explicit human-in-the-loop oversight gates.

clauses.name: Accuracy, Robustness & Cybersecurity
clauses.gap: High-risk systems require continuous accuracy/robustness monitoring (recent drift evaluations).

clauses.name: Transparency & Information to Deployers

evidence.pass: Documented purpose with a named owner ({ownerTeam})
evidence.fail: Deployer information incomplete: needs a substantive purpose and a named accountable owner

clauses.gap: High-risk systems must give deployers clear use instructions and an identified accountable owner.

clauses.name: Provider Responsibilities Along the Value Chain

evidence.fail: No provider / build origin recorded for this system

clauses.gap: High-risk systems must identify the provider (internal or third party) responsible along the value chain.

clauses.name: Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment
clauses.gap: High-risk deployers must complete a fundamental-rights impact assessment (attach a dpia artifact).

clauses.name: Post-Market Monitoring

evidence.pass: Active post-market monitoring: business-continuity plan configured with recent drift evaluations
evidence.fail: Post-market monitoring incomplete: needs a configured continuity plan and recent drift evaluations

clauses.gap: High-risk providers must operate a documented post-market monitoring plan (continuity plan + ongoing drift evaluation).

clauses.name: Quality Management System
clauses.gap: High-risk providers must operate a quality-management system with a planned internal audit cadence.

clauses.name: Deployer Operational Record

evidence.fail: No deployment date recorded — operation cannot be monitored from a known start

clauses.gap: Deployers of high-risk systems must record the deployment date so operation is monitored from putting-into-service.

clauses.name: Transparency & Disclosure
clauses.gap: Limited risk systems must provide clear use case descriptions for user transparency.

evidence.pass: Minimal risk model. Complies by default.
